mapper.select: SELECT sales_delivery_id FROM tb_sales_delivery_hd WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND sales_delivery_id = #{salesDeliveryId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND use_at = 'Y' FOR UPDATE

SELECT h.sales_delivery_id AS "salesDeliveryId", h.delivery_no AS "deliveryNo", to_char(h.delivery_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "deliveryDt", h.delivery_type AS "deliveryType", c.customer_name AS "customerName", h.total_amt AS "totalAmt" FROM tb_sales_delivery_hd h JOIN tb_customer_info c ON c.customer_id = h.customer_id AND c.tenant_id = h.tenant_id WHERE h.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND h.use_at = 'Y' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_sales_statement_hd s WHERE s.tenant_id = h.tenant_id AND s.sales_delivery_id = h.sales_delivery_id AND s.use_at = 'Y') AND (#{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '' OR h.delivery_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' OR c.customer_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%') ORDER BY h.delivery_dt DESC, h.sales_delivery_id DESC LIMIT 200

INSERT INTO tb_sales_statement_hd ( tenant_id, sales_delivery_id, statement_no, statement_dt, delivery_no, delivery_dt, delivery_type, order_no, supplier_name, supplier_business_no, supplier_president_name, supplier_business_type, supplier_business_category, supplier_post_code, supplier_address, supplier_telephone_no, supplier_facsimile_no, supplier_stamp_image, customer_code, customer_name, customer_business_no, customer_president_name, customer_business_type, customer_business_category, customer_post_code, customer_address, customer_telephone_no, customer_facsimile_no, total_amt, remark, created_by) SELECT h.tenant_id, h.sales_delivery_id, #{statementNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{statementDt, jdbcType=DATE}, h.delivery_no, h.delivery_dt, h.delivery_type, o.order_no, t.tenant_nm, t.business_registration_number, t.president_name, t.business_type, t.business_category, t.post_code, t.address, t.telephone_no, t.facsimile_no, t.stamp_image, c.customer_code, c.customer_name, c.business_no, c.president_name, c.business_item_1, c.business_status_1, c.post_code, c.address, c.telephone_no, c.facsimile_no, h.total_amt, #{remark, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} FROM tb_sales_delivery_hd h JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = h.tenant_id JOIN tb_customer_info c ON c.customer_id = h.customer_id AND c.tenant_id = h.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_sales_order_hd o ON o.sales_order_id = h.sales_order_id AND o.tenant_id = h.tenant_id WHERE h.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND h.sales_delivery_id = #{salesDeliveryId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND h.use_at = 'Y' RETURNING sales_statement_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_sales_statement_dt ( sales_statement_id, tenant_id, line_no, material_code, material_name, material_spec, unit, delivery_qty, unit_price, supply_amt, vat_amt, total_amt) SELECT #{salesStatementId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, d.tenant_id, d.line_no, m.material_code, m.material_name, m.material_spec, m.unit, d.delivery_qty, d.unit_price, d.supply_amt, d.vat_amt, d.total_amt FROM tb_sales_delivery_dt d LEFT JOIN tb_material_info m ON m.material_id = d.material_id AND m.tenant_id = d.tenant_id WHERE d.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND d.sales_delivery_id = #{salesDeliveryId, jdbcType=BIGINT}
mapper.select: SELECT h.sales_statement_id AS "salesStatementId", h.sales_delivery_id AS "salesDeliveryId", h.statement_no AS "statementNo", to_char(h.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "statementDt", h.delivery_no AS "deliveryNo", to_char(h.delivery_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "deliveryDt", h.delivery_type AS "deliveryType", h.order_no AS "orderNo", h.supplier_name AS "supplierName", h.supplier_business_no AS "supplierBusinessNo", h.supplier_president_name AS "supplierPresidentName", h.supplier_business_type AS "supplierBusinessType", h.supplier_business_category AS "supplierBusinessCategory", h.supplier_post_code AS "supplierPostCode", h.supplier_address AS "supplierAddress", h.supplier_telephone_no AS "supplierTelephoneNo", h.supplier_facsimile_no AS "supplierFacsimileNo", COALESCE(h.supplier_stamp_image, t.stamp_image) AS "supplierStampImage", h.customer_code AS "customerCode", h.customer_name AS "customerName", h.customer_business_no AS "customerBusinessNo", h.customer_president_name AS "customerPresidentName", h.customer_business_type AS "customerBusinessType", h.customer_business_category AS "customerBusinessCategory", h.customer_post_code AS "customerPostCode", h.customer_address AS "customerAddress", h.customer_telephone_no AS "customerTelephoneNo", h.customer_facsimile_no AS "customerFacsimileNo", h.total_amt AS "totalAmt", h.remark AS "remark", h.created_by AS "createdBy", to_char(h.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "createdAt", u.user_nm AS "createdByName", la.profile_image AS "createdByProfileImage" FROM tb_sales_statement_hd h LEFT JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = h.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_login_account la ON la.login_code = h.created_by AND la.tenant_id = h.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.login_id = la.login_id AND u.tenant_id = la.tenant_id WHERE h.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND h.sales_statement_id = #{salesStatementId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND h.use_at = 'Y'

SELECT sales_statement_detail_id AS "salesStatementDetailId", line_no AS "lineNo", material_code AS "materialCode", material_name AS "materialName", material_spec AS "materialSpec", unit, delivery_qty AS "deliveryQty", unit_price AS "unitPrice", supply_amt AS "supplyAmt", vat_amt AS "vatAmt", total_amt AS "totalAmt" FROM tb_sales_statement_dt WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND sales_statement_id = #{salesStatementId, jdbcType=BIGINT} ORDER BY line_no

SELECT h.sales_statement_id AS "salesStatementId", h.statement_no AS "statementNo", to_char(h.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "statementDt", h.delivery_no AS "deliveryNo", h.customer_code AS "customerCode", h.customer_name AS "customerName", h.total_amt AS "totalAmt", d.sales_statement_detail_id AS "salesStatementDetailId", d.line_no AS "lineNo", d.material_code AS "materialCode", d.material_name AS "materialName", d.material_spec AS "materialSpec", d.unit, d.delivery_qty AS "deliveryQty", d.unit_price AS "unitPrice", d.supply_amt AS "supplyAmt", d.vat_amt AS "vatAmt", d.total_amt AS "lineTotalAmt" FROM tb_sales_statement_hd h JOIN tb_sales_statement_dt d ON d.sales_statement_id = h.sales_statement_id AND d.tenant_id = h.tenant_id WHERE h.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND h.use_at = 'Y' AND h.statement_dt BETWEEN #{from, jdbcType=DATE} AND #{to, jdbcType=DATE} AND (#{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '' OR h.statement_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' OR h.delivery_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' OR h.customer_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' OR d.material_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%') ORDER BY h.statement_dt DESC, h.sales_statement_id DESC, d.line_no
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_sales_statement_hd SET statement_dt = #{statementDt, jdbcType=DATE}, remark = #{remark, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updated_by = #{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND sales_statement_id = #{salesStatementId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND use_at = 'Y'

UPDATE tb_sales_statement_hd SET use_at = 'N', updated_by = #{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND sales_statement_id = #{salesStatementId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND use_at = 'Y'
